current_status.stage: Approved & commercially launched in EU (as Oczyesa, first launched Germany Nov 2025) and UK; US NDA under second FDA review after two manufacturing/cGMP-related Complete Response Letters (CRLs) — second resubmission accepted Jul 17, 2026, PDUFA target action date Dec 18, 2026
current_status.dosing_target: Once-monthly self-administered subcutaneous depot via prefilled FluidCrystal autoinjector pen
current_status.data_point: US FDA CRL #2 issued Jun 10, 2026 (manufacturing/facility-related, explicitly not efficacy/safety); resubmission accepted for review Jul 17, 2026 with PDUFA target action date of Dec 18, 2026

finding_history.summary: FDA issues a Complete Response Letter (CRL) for the CAM2029 (octreotide) NDA in acromegaly, citing facility-related deficiencies found during a September 2024 cGMP inspection of a third-party manufacturer. FDA states no concerns related to clinical efficacy or safety.

European Commission grants marketing authorization for Oczyesa® (CAM2029) in the EU for adult acromegaly patients who have responded to and tolerated somatostatin analogs, following an April 2025 CHMP positive opinion — Camurus's first regulatory approval for this asset.

UK MHRA grants marketing authorization for Oczyesa® (CAM2029) for maintenance treatment of adult acromegaly patients who have responded to and tolerated somatostatin analogs; company targets a Q4 2025 UK commercial launch.
Camurus commercially launches Oczyesa® in Germany — the first EU country to receive the product — with subsequent launches planned across additional EU markets.

FDA accepts Camurus's resubmission (filed Dec 10, 2025) of the CAM2029/Oclaiz NDA for acromegaly, assigning a PDUFA target action date of June 10, 2026. Application supported by seven clinical studies including the two Phase 3 ACROINNOVA trials.

FDA issues a second Complete Response Letter for the CAM2029/Oclaiz NDA, again citing observations from the September 2024 cGMP inspection of a third-party manufacturer and recommending a labeling change for the packaging's oxygen absorber component; FDA states this CRL does not relate to clinical efficacy or safety. Camurus reiterates no change to its 2026 financial outlook and plans near-term resubmission.
FDA accepts Camurus's second NDA resubmission for CAM2029/Oclaiz in acromegaly, assigning a new PDUFA target action date of December 18, 2026.
